This showcases his remarkable reliability and sustained high-level play, making him a crucial asset in the league.

articles.title: Indian Navy eyes indigenous SATCOM terminals to boost network-centric warfare
articles.summary: The Indian Navy is seeking indigenous satellite communication terminals for its warships to bolster network-centric warfare capabilities. These advanced systems are crucial for enhancing communication reliability in harsh maritime conditions. This initiative aligns with India's focus on self-reliance in defence technology, ensuring robust operational readiness and strengthening the fleet's strategic communication infrastructure at sea.

articles.title: PR can polish picture of GDP, but not economy itself: Congress slams Modi government
articles.summary: The Congress party criticized the Modi government, citing former finance secretary Subhash Chandra Garg's reported remarks on GDP numbers. Congress alleged that the government prioritizes public relations over accurate economic data, stating that "PR can polish" but not fundamentally change realities. This political attack highlights ongoing debate regarding the nation's economic performance and data integrity under the current administration.

articles.title: Auto sector must focus on building global leadership with scale: Industry leaders
articles.summary: Industry leaders in New Delhi urged India's auto sector to transcend mere resilience. They advocated for building globally competitive, technology-rich, and sustainable domestic value chains. This strategic shift is crucial for fostering long-term growth and enhancing India's global standing. It emphasizes innovation and environmental responsibility, aiming to establish India as a premier automotive hub beyond just overcoming immediate challenges.

articles.title: 'It's a military secret': Putin taunts Britain over possible plan to target UK defence plants for its support of Ukraine
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin taunted Britain, stating it's a 'military secret' if Russia would target UK defence plants, including drone makers. This provocative declaration, made to state media, escalates rhetoric and raises concerns about the security of UK defence infrastructure. It suggests potential retaliatory measures and highlights the unpredictable nature of current geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Trump says US could still ‘smack’ Iran
articles.summary: US President Trump asserted the Strait of Hormuz is in "extremely good shape," contrasting this with Iran's reportedly deteriorating economy, military, and leadership. These comments highlight ongoing geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran regarding a vital global shipping lane. Trump's remarks also hinted at potential future actions, underscoring continued vigilance and the complex strategic dynamics in the region.

articles.title: Nepal flash flood gives IAF another opportunity to demonstrate its airlift capability
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force recently delivered relief supplies to Nepal, showcasing its crucial global reach and strategic capabilities. Past operations in Jammu & Kashmir and East Pakistan, alongside recent deployments to Ladakh and the Maldives, highlight its operational versatility and India's growing role as a regional security provider.

articles.title: Harold Holt, the Australian prime minister who disappeared while swimming
articles.summary: Almost 60 years ago, Australia's Prime Minister, Harold Holt, mysteriously vanished while swimming off the coast of Victoria in December 1967. Elected only 22 months prior, his disappearance remains a notable historical enigma in Australian politics, sparking decades of speculation and investigation into the fate of a serving head of government.
